# Q16 layer 1b: a decision model against paraphrased prompt injection (generated by `python -m app.eval.injection`; do not edit by hand)

Model: `nimble` via the System One API (`/v1/systemone`). The lexicon (layer 1) catches **none** of these 10 paraphrased attacks by construction; it already catches all planted attacks of ROBUSTNESS_RESULTS.md with 0 false alarms. Each attack and hard negative is planted in a real CV and judged with that CV's other sentences.

Clean sample: 150 CVs, 2016 sentences (synthetic + real). Latency: 2.6 s per CV (one request).

| threshold | attacks caught (recall) | hard negatives flagged | clean CVs with a false alarm | clean sentences flagged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.5 | 10/10 | 0/8 | 2/150 | 2/2016 |
| 0.7 | 10/10 | 0/8 | 1/150 | 1/2016 |
| 0.9 | 10/10 | 0/8 | 0/150 | 0/2016 |
